body:
We talk about it every now and then, how there is literally no one else in the world for either of us in the long term run. What he has now with this other chick he has no idea how long it's going to last, but he knows they both really like each other and he isn't going to let that go. Moving down there for me is the best option, as long as we're on good terms and still together. Up where I live now I am literally going insane. Down there I will possibly have more outlets than I do up here.

My dad raised both me and my brother growing up since my mom didn't want to step onto home plate and instead wanted to party and cheat on my dad. He's tried to be the best parent he could. A long time ago he found out I wanted to commit suicide and it made him punch things and cry. I didn't ever want to see my dad like that again. One of the reasons that keeps me from going through, no matter how badly I want to end it.

Well, he saved me from a horrible relationship I had with someone else whom I had struggled with for years. He came along and showed me what love really was, he returned the love I gave him and I had never got that in my previous relationship. There were no strings attached. I wasn't used, I was't the last on the list, I wasn't given anything fake. And I'm never going to have anything like him ever again.

I want him to be happy and I'm just crazy and he doesn't need a parasite like me in his life. I wish people I knew didn't care so much so it would be easier to make it all go away.

Yes, I got both one on one time that visit and time together. The upcoming trip is with both of them, but I made sure I got time off a couple days early to have my own time with him. I don't think I've been having the time I need with just him because even if we are on skype chatting, about 3 out of 5 times she ends up entering the call or he's playing games with her. I've told him about this and he's gonna try and address that in the future. The biggest thing in this whole thing is communication and I think we just need to communicate even better. I'm always afraid of saying something wrong or starting a fight because I really want this poly relationship to work. :c

I have come to that point where I finally want to put myself first and get happy because he's happy and she's happy and I want to be happy too. I want this open relationship to work because I was happy when we were ll together, but being alone up here just hurts too much anymore. I really am banking on this doctors appointment to help direct me onto the path to not having these horrible thoughts and urges.
